pairs.question: Si quid huic acciderit, quem in eius locum substituetis?
pairs.derivation: Catulus, dissuading the lex granting Pompey the pirate command, asks the contio whom they would substitute if anything happened to Pompey; the whole assembly shouts back the answer. Dropped the speech-framing narration before the question (the indirect-speech setup ending '...neque omnia in uno reponenda adiecissetque:') and the framing 'subclamavit universa contio:' before the answer, plus the trailing narration 'Tum ille victus consensu omnium...'. Question normalized to initial capital and '?'; answer normalized to initial capital and terminal '.'. Both utterances are verbatim and contiguous.
